title: Tech Note: WebSTAR: Front End for 4D Business Kit
featured_technology: Mac OS X web front-end configuration

historical_commentary.text: This note describes configuring the 4D WebSTAR web server as a front-end for 4D Business Kit, an e-commerce/business application product from the mid-2000s Mac OS X era. Both 4D WebSTAR and 4D Business Kit have long been discontinued and are not part of any current 4D product line, making this note obsolete as a practical guide; 4D's own built-in Web Server has since become the standard way to expose 4D applications over HTTP. Only the teaser paragraph could be recovered for this note.
related_updates: 4D WebSTAR and 4D Business Kit have both been discontinued for many years
4D's built-in Web Server (and later REST/ORDA-based web services) replaced this class of standalone front-end web server products
